issues.label: Meaning of 'deliberate removal' under R.C. 2745.01(C)
issues.why: The central dispute is whether the statutory phrase covers only affirmative removal or also failure to repair/replace guards.

issues.label: Failure to repair versus affirmative removal
issues.why: Court must decide whether not replacing a guard that fell off during use constitutes 'removal.'

issues.label: Who removed the PTO coupling guard
issues.why: The presumption applies only if the employer, not a third party or normal wear, caused removal.

issues.label: Whether removal must be deliberate/intentional act
issues.why: The statute requires a deliberate decision to remove, not mere negligence or omission.

issues.label: Reviewability of summary-judgment denial after trial
issues.why: Denial of summary judgment on evidentiary sufficiency is generally not reviewable following a full trial on the merits.

issues.label: Genuine issue of material fact existed
issues.why: Court must assess whether the summary-judgment record raised triable issues on deliberate removal.

issues.label: Existence of 'equipment safety guard'
issues.why: The PTO shaft and coupling guards must qualify as statutory equipment safety guards.

issues.label: Direct-result causation for presumption
issues.why: The presumption applies only if injury occurred as a direct result of the guard's removal.

issues.label: Rebuttal of the presumption of intent
issues.why: Whether Gill Dairy rebutted intent by proving it did not intend to injure Camara.

issues.label: Proof of intent to injure absent presumption
issues.why: Without the presumption, plaintiff must prove deliberate intent under R.C. 2745.01(A) and (B).

issues.label: Correctness of jury instructions
issues.why: Whether instructions accurately conveyed the deliberate-removal standard and burden shifting.

issues.label: Validity of jury interrogatories
issues.why: Whether the interrogatories properly framed the elements and presumption allocation.

issues.label: Burden of proof allocation
issues.why: Whether burden properly shifted to employer to rebut once removal was shown.

issues.label: Sufficiency/weight of evidence supporting verdict
issues.why: Whether trial evidence supported findings of deliberate removal and causation.

issues.label: Employment and course-of-employment elements
issues.why: Plaintiff must establish he was an employee acting within course of employment.

issues.label: Effect of employee's own conduct/comparative fault
issues.why: Camara operated running machinery to investigate a leak, raising causation questions.

issues.label: Relevance of spoliation/altered document evidence
issues.why: Whether altered quote evidence was properly admitted and affected the tort verdict.

issues.label: Timing of guard removal relative to injury
issues.why: Whether a 2016 pump-replacement removal supports statutory liability years later.

issues.label: Damages amount and support
issues.why: Whether the $1,934,000 compensatory award is supported by evidence.
